queue.heading: Report queue
queue.intro: Most urgent first. Our own moderators act on reports. The only automatic check is on pictures: it holds a flagged picture for a moderator and never decides on its own.
queue.grouped: Reports about the same item are grouped into one case.
queue.notAllowed: Only moderation staff can see the queue.

tierSummary.heading: Open cases by tier
tierSummary.one_hour: Removal orders from an authority (EU law gives us one hour)
tierSummary.same_day: Child abuse material, a threat to a minor, a self-harm risk or terrorist content
tierSummary.two_days: Other illegal content, such as copied work
tierSummary.seven_days: Everything else: insults, spam, off-topic posts

case.heading: Case {{reference}}
case.notFound: There is no case here, or it is not one you can see.
case.notAllowed: Only moderation staff can open a case.
case.summaryOrder: {{what}}. A removal order from an authority, received {{when}}. The one-hour clock started on receipt.
case.summaryPicture: {{what}}. Held by the picture check {{when}}; nobody else has seen it.
case.noReports: No reports: this case came from an order or a picture check.
case.anonymous: Reporters are never named to the reported account.
case.decidedNotice: This case is decided: {{action}}. Appeals come with S1-E10-07.

form.heading: Decision
form.noteHint: What you checked and why you chose this action. Only staff can read it.
form.noteMissing: Write a note to send the decision.
form.sent: Decision saved. The case is closed and its reports with it.
form.nextSteps: The action is carried out at once: a warning, a suspension, a ban, hiding or removing. The statement of reasons to the account comes with S1-E10-04.
form.daysMissing: Choose how long the suspension lasts.

case.summary: {{what}}. Reports: {{count}}, the first received {{when}}. Reports about the same item are grouped here.

failures.not_allowed: You can’t do this. Only moderation staff can, and safeguarding cases need the safeguarding permission.
failures.refused: The database refused it: the note may be empty, or the case is already decided.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
failures.not_built: Restricting an item comes with S1-E11-08.

reason.hint: Goes into the audit log. Only staff can read it.

moderatedItem.hidden: The item is hidden: the writer and staff still see it.
moderatedItem.removed: The item is removed: only staff see it; everyone else sees “[Removed by the moderation team]”.
moderatedItem.explain: Staff never edit a writer’s words. Restoring brings the item back as it was.

notices.anonymous: No name or email given (allowed for child sexual content)
notices.ordersHeading: Removal orders received in the last 7 days
notices.orderUnmatched: The address matched nothing we host: check it below.
notices.unmatchedIntro: The address in these notices matched nothing we host. Check each one, act on the content if you find it, then close the notice with what you found.
